entities.summary: Serhiy Vitaliiovych Nadal is a Ukrainian politician who is the mayor of Ternopil and the head of the Ternopil urban hromada in western Ukraine. A member of the Svoboda party, Nadal has been mayor since November 2010. Nadal's 2010 election was the first mayoral election won by Svoboda.
